prompt: Builds need a GPU pool, a route into the private network, and full control of the base image. Which runner model fits?
explanation: Custom hardware, network position, and OS control are the three classic reasons to self-host: your machines, registered with GitHub, targeted by label. GitHub-hosted runners offer managed convenience and bigger sizes, never your GPUs or your subnet.

options.text: GitHub-hosted runners with a larger size
Self-hosted runners on your own machines
